summary: This topic explains how the system handles overpayments (extra fees) and automatically adjusts them against future installments or other pending fee heads, based on a configurable setting.
steps: When an overpayment occurs (e.g., a student pays more than the due amount, or a concession is applied after a full payment), the excess amount is recorded as 'Extra Fee'.
If the 'Auto Adjust Extra Fee' toggle is enabled (typically found in Fee Setup or Institute Preferences), the system will automatically adjust this extra fee.
The system prioritizes adjusting the extra fee against the next available pending fee head in the current period.
If no current dues exist, the adjustment will be applied to future installments or next month's dues.
business_rules: If the 'Auto Adjust Extra Fee' setting is enabled, any overpayment is automatically adjusted by the system.
Adjustment occurs against the first available pending fee head.
If no dues are pending in the current period, the extra fee will be adjusted against dues in subsequent periods (e.g., next month).
important_notes: An 'auto remark' is generated by the system to indicate that an amount has been auto-adjusted.
Care should be taken when cancelling receipts related to extra fees or concessions, as this can lead to negative balances if not managed properly.
The system will attempt to adjust the extra fee to the most relevant pending fee head first.
